description: anvilml-testui: Events panel HTML — full panel replacing Phase 001 stub
context: Replace Phase 001 Events stub in index.html. (1) Controls: #ws-connect-btn, #ws-disconnect-btn (disabled), #ws-status ('● Disconnected' .status-error), #ws-clear-btn, #ws-auto-scroll (checkbox checked). (2) Filters: 10 checkboxes id=ws-filter-<event-type> (dots to dashes) for all WsEvent types per ANVILML_DESIGN §4.6: job-queued/started/progress/image-ready/completed/failed/cancelled, worker-status, system-stats, provisioning-progress; all checked. (3) #ws-counters div. (4) #ws-log div class='ws-log response'. python3 check: all 17 Events panel IDs present.

description: anvilml-testui: WebSocket engine — wsConnect, wsDisconnect, onmessage
context: In app.js WEBSOCKET: wsConnect() builds wsUrl replacing http(s):// with ws(s):// then appending /v1/events; new WebSocket; onopen: #ws-status connected+status-ok, toggle buttons; onclose: reset status, ws=null; onerror: append [ERROR] to #ws-log; onmessage->handleWsMessage(e.data). wsDisconnect() ws.close() if ws and readyState not CLOSED. handleWsMessage(raw): JSON.parse; check ws-filter-<event-dots-to-dashes> checkbox; increment wsCounters[msg.event]; renderWsCounters(); appendWsLogEntry(msg) creates div.ws-entry with JSON text, append, scroll if wsAutoScroll. node --check app.js exits 0.

description: anvilml-testui: Events panel — counters, clear, auto-scroll, CSS polish
context: In app.js PANEL:EVENTS: renderWsCounters() clears #ws-counters, creates span.ws-counter for each of 10 event types showing 'event.type: N'. handleWsClear() empties #ws-log, resets wsCounters={}, calls renderWsCounters(). INIT: renderWsCounters() on load; wire ws-connect-btn/ws-disconnect-btn/ws-clear-btn/ws-auto-scroll. styles.css: .ws-entry {border-bottom,padding:4px 0,font-size:11px,white-space:pre-wrap}, .ws-entry-system-stats {color:var(--text-muted)}, .ws-entry-job-completed {color:var(--green)}, .ws-entry-job-failed {color:var(--red)}. node --check app.js exits 0.
